description: Angular component for configuring legend settings in a widget, including form handling, input bindings, and change detection.

classes.name: LegendConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component for legend configuration in widget settings, implementing ControlValueAccessor for form integration.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form and subscribes to form value changes.

methods.name: onDirectionChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the legend direction, adjusting position if necessary.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Unsubscribes from form change subscriptions to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the form value changes.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates the form with a given LegendConfig object.

methods.name: legendConfigUpdated
methods.description: Updates the external form value when internal form changes.

methods.name: getShowValues
methods.description: Extracts show value flags from LegendConfig into an array of strings.

methods.name: setShowValues
methods.description: Sets show value flags on LegendConfig based on an array of strings.
